verdict.rationale: Graphite's documented AI review runs on pull requests after they are opened ("analyze every pull request", "automatically review all new pull requests"). Its IDE extension is described only as a GUI for visual stacking, not as a place to run the review. Nothing in the evidence shows the same review running in the editor before a push, so the VSCode extension is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I get the same review inside my IDE before I push, catching issues while the code is still in my editor
